entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...We discovered that there was no[n]corpse in the morgue.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: What a surprise... To think you'd pull[n]the wool over my eyes.

entries.speaker: Detective
entries.en: —you're[n]the leader of the Phantom Thieves,[n]aren't you?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: No. It's certainly this young man. I have[n]evidence on him.

entries.speaker: Detective
entries.en: You used a mysterious power to show[n]an illusion to Goro Akechi, as well as[n]shot and killed a guard.

entries.speaker: Detective
entries.en: You better not try anything funny. We're[n]authorized to shoot if needed this time.
